title: Large Language Model-based Actor-Critic (LLaMAC)

defines.name: LLaMAC
defines.definition: A modular large-language-model-based actor-critic framework for large-scale multi-agent decision-making that uses a centralized critic and iterative actor interactions to improve coordination and efficiency.

problem: Large-scale LLM-based multi-agent decision-making suffers from hallucinations, poor coordination, and inefficient token use as the number of agents grows.
